Katie Volynets (born December 31, 2001) is an American professional tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 56 by the WTA , achieved on July 29, 2024. [ 2 ] Early life [ edit ] Volynets was born in Walnut Creek, California . Her parents had emigrated from Ukraine, and she still has extended family in Kyiv and Dnipro . [ 3 ] Career [ edit ] 2019: Grand Slam tournament debut [ edit ] On August 11, 2019, Volynets won the USTA Girls 18s National Championships final over Emma Navarro , earning her a wildcard entry into the singles main draw of the US Open . [ 4 ] She lost in the first round to eventual champion Bianca Andreescu . [ 5 ] 2021: Indian Wells and Wimbledon debuts [ edit ] In May, she won her first singles title on the ITF Circuit , at the $100k event in Bonita Springs. [ 6 ] She qualified for the Wimbledon Championships , losing to Irina-Camelia Begu in the first round.
